devdoc.details: The kernel manages modules and policies. The kernel is mutated via predefined Actions,which are input from any address assigned as the executor. The executor can be changed as needed.

modulePermissions.details: Keycode -> Policy -> Function Selector -> bool for permission

allKeycodes(uint256).notice: Array of all modules currently installed.

executeAction(uint8,address).notice: Main kernel function. Initiates state changes to kernel depending on Action passed in.

executor().notice: Address that is able to initiate Actions in the kernel. Can be assigned to a multisig or governance contract.

getDependentIndex(bytes5,address).notice: Helper for module dependent arrays. Prevents the need to loop through array.

getKeycodeForModule(address).notice: Mapping of keycode to module address.

getModuleForKeycode(bytes5).notice: Mapping of module address to keycode.

getPolicyIndex(address).notice: Helper to get active policy quickly. Prevents need to loop through array.

moduleDependents(bytes5,uint256).notice: Mapping of a keycode to all of its policy dependents. Used to efficiently reconfigure policy dependencies.

userdoc.notice: Main contract that acts as a central component registry for the protocol.
